09-ai-copilot-endpoint.note: POST /api/copilot streams Kimi K2 (model slug kimi-k2.6, OpenAI SDK against api.moonshot.ai/v1). Context assembler reads profiles + preferences + last-20 app_calorie_entries + last-20 events via the user's session client (RLS enforces owner-scoping as defence-in-depth on top of explicit .eq('user_id', userId)). Serialization = pretty JSON, 6000-char cap, evenly truncates entries+events newest-first when over budget; profile/preferences never truncated. SSE frame formats: {"delta": token} for content, {"reasoning": token} for Kimi's reasoning_content deltas (UI can hide), {"error": msg} on upstream failure, [DONE] terminator. Guards: 401 on missing session, 400 on empty/malformed messages, 400 when messages.length > 20. Endpoint writes nothing to the DB. Escape hatch: added allowImportingTsExtensions: true to apps/web/tsconfig.json so the pre-existing .ts extensions in packages/shared/src/{index,types/index}.ts compile — this is the first web-side consumer of @nothing/shared so the latent issue only surfaced now. pnpm typecheck + pnpm build both clean; live Kimi smoke test returned streaming SSE chunks.
